decision: Retain Vulkan vertex shader conditional blending; measured actor workloads benefit. Static control has no benefit and a small possible regression requiring hardware validation.
change: Preserve the first weighted matrix and conditionally accumulate each nonzero remaining influence in forward, G-buffer and shadow vertex shaders. No influence truncation, LOD, resolution or lighting changes.

method.host: shared AMD EPYC 9V74 VM; four CPU quota
method.scene: 1000 props + 32 independently animated 64-bone/2048-vertex actors; static control 256 props
method.screen: 3 alternating pairs; 60 warmup +90 measured frames; original two-weight fixture
method.expanded: 2 alternating pairs per configuration; 60 warmup +60 measured frames; explicit one/four weights or two weights with shadows
method.aggregation: Median of per-run frame means; percentiles are medians of per-run percentiles, not pooled
method.execution: No concurrent builds or tests during measurements
limits: Software-driver measurements do not establish physical GPU gains.
Short shared-VM runs do not establish statistical significance or tail-latency gains.
Four-active-weight improvement cannot be attributed to eliminating zero-weight reads; shader compiler scheduling/register effects were not separately measured.
Static control average is 1.8% slower; investigate on physical GPUs before release-wide performance claims.

validation.spirvVal: passed for all three changed vertex shaders
validation.cpuReferenceImageTest: passed: graphics.skinning.sparseWeightsMatchCpuReference, 20 assertions; mixed sparse/non-leading-zero weights in ForwardPlus and Hybrid compared with CPU-deformed geometry
validation.architecture: Implementation-only Vulkan shaders and benchmark/test extension; no public API, ECS/lifetime, module boundary or persistent format changes; no exceptions
validation.measuredShaderArtifactsMatchFinal: all three SPIR-V and embedded arrays byte-identical to measured candidate
validation.runnerSmoke: passed: three-influence mixed scene, full render, explicit workload field checked
